plainTranslation: Person B (Venus)'s way of expressing affection and seeking enjoyment can differ from Person A (Jupiter)'s judgment about what is generous, worthwhile or enough. Mutual admiration may remain strong, while each encourages an expression the other experiences as excessive or not quite suited to what is wanted. Person A (Jupiter) may offer more than Person B (Venus) finds satisfying; Person B (Venus)'s response can in turn affect how appreciated Person A (Jupiter) feels. The opposition concerns the relation between affection, enjoyment and expansive goodwill, not an absence of attraction. Extravagance or overindulgence is a possible development. The contact alone does not establish which person overdoes it, who has greater planetary strength or that a disagreement about money already exists.

summaryDeep: Their confidence, encouragement, and appetite for possibility press against your affections, tastes, and sense of worth. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
tension: The tension appears when your differences start to feel like judgments. A difference in perspective can slowly harden into a question of whose truth gets to lead. They may experience your caution as a limit on what is possible, while you may experience their faith in expansion as a refusal to acknowledge reality. Over time, what began as a difference in style can become a story about who has the better way of moving through life.
advice: This connection is not about proving whose approach is right. It is about recognizing that both of your instincts can become excessive in different ways, and finding a balance that serves the relationship better than either extreme. Neither person needs to become the other. The goal is to find a balance where generosity has room to breathe and good judgment still has a voice.
summaryShort: Their confidence, encouragement, and appetite for possibility press against your affections, tastes, and sense of worth.
